TRIVIAL-01.rationale: Single standalone file performing pure mathematical calculations with no external dependencies or state.

TRIVIAL-02.rationale: Single-file CLI script with basic argument parsing and file reading.

TRIVIAL-04.rationale: Single file conversion utility script with standard library.

TRIVIAL-05.rationale: Single file health probe script with exit code status.

SIMPLE-01.rationale: Single-tier client-side application with HTML/CSS/JS, interactive DOM components, and local browser persistence.

SIMPLE-02.rationale: Client-side frontend application with media controls, tags, and local persistence.

SIMPLE-03.rationale: Frontend dashboard with form inputs, KPI summary cards, filtering, and localStorage.

SIMPLE-04.rationale: Client-side financial calculator dashboard with currency conversion table and persistent settings.

SIMPLE-05.rationale: Client-side web app with split-pane layout, note management, and browser persistence.

MEDIUM-01.rationale: Multi-endpoint backend web service with database models, CRUD operations, relationships, and SQLite persistence.

MEDIUM-02.rationale: Async REST API with request validation models, relational database storage, and status transition logic.

MEDIUM-03.rationale: Backend service managing multi-entity inventory records, transactions, and relational queries.

MEDIUM-04.rationale: Relational backend service with multiple models, routing logic, validation, and database storage.

MEDIUM-05.rationale: Structured backend service with status tracking, history logs, schema definitions, and REST endpoints.

COMPLEX-01.rationale: Multi-tier system requiring authentication middleware, token lifecycles, schema migrations, asynchronous workers, and external webhooks.

COMPLEX-02.rationale: Complex multi-tier platform with RBAC, database migrations, asynchronous job workers, and versioning.

COMPLEX-03.rationale: Platform with third-party payment integration, webhook security, state machine transitions, and background queues.

COMPLEX-04.rationale: Enterprise architecture with auth security, scheduled calculation workers, database migrations, and audit trails.

COMPLEX-05.rationale: Multi-component commercial system with authentication, background processing, database migrations, and payment gateways.

LARGE-01.rationale: Distributed multi-service architecture with asynchronous event streaming, RPC contracts, service discovery, and container orchestration.

LARGE-02.rationale: High-scale distributed streaming data pipeline with streaming bus, time-series storage, caching layer, and Kubernetes orchestration.

LARGE-03.rationale: Distributed event-driven system with distributed saga compensation logic, broker routing, and container orchestration.

LARGE-04.rationale: Monorepo distributed system with telemetry collection, distributed ingestion, multiple microservices, and orchestration.

LARGE-05.rationale: Distributed consensus and partitioned ledger architecture with multi-node replication and Kubernetes infrastructure.
